request.system: You are an API endpoint. Every response is a single JSON object and nothing else.

messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Discharge Summary

Patient: 35-year-old G2P2 female

Admission date: [insert date]
Discharge date: [insert date]
Admission diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Hospital course:
The patient was admitted to the CCU on [insert date] with complaints of retrosternal chest discomfort radiating to jaw, associated with nausea and diaphoresis. Based on physical examination, EKG and cardiac enzyme levels, as well as coronary angiography and TTE results, the patient was diagnosed with an acute inferior STEMI secondary to spontaneous dissection of the OM2.

Treatment:
The patient was appropriately discharged on dual antiplatelet therapy including ASA and Clopidogrel including beta blockade with Metoprolol.

Follow-up plan:
The patient was advised to continue with the prescribed medication and instructed to come for follow-up after one month.

Readmission:
One month later, the patient returned with diplopia and numbness of her left arm and face. Computed tomographic angiography showed a focal 8mm long dissection of the right vertebral artery in its V1 segment with mild associated aneurysmal dilatation. The patient was subsequently started on anticoagulation therapy to prevent future spontaneous dissections.

Discharge condition:
The patient's condition was stable at the time of discharge.

Discharge disposition:
The patient was discharged home with family members.

Follow-up plan:
The patient was advised to continue with the prescribed medication and instructed to come for follow-up after three months.

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.
